name: America the Beautiful: America's Majestic Landscapes
original_name: America the Beautiful: America's Majestic Landscapes
overview: The National Parks system stretches across thousands of miles, from sea to shining sea—but now you can take it all in, in one majestic sweep! America the Beautiful carries you from the depths of Death Valley to the heights of Mount Rushmore; from the lush forests of the Everglades to the rugged terrain of Yellowstone! The collection is packed with information about the spotlighted parks; and every invigorating vista is captured in High Definition, on beautiful Blu Ray, giving you a front row seat to nature's splendour!
